Fixed file sync resource leaks and reduced sync overhead in preparation for Chelys integration

*  Released FilePizza uploaders per request instead of retaining them until global teardown, preventing accumulation of open WebRTC peers and pinned file payloads
* Bounded the processed-requests set by pruning entries on request completion, verification, and cleanup
* Cached local file checksums by id and lastModified so unchanged files are no longer re-read or re-hashed every cycle
* Computed the local file list once per sync cycle and passed it through instead of recomputing it
* Tagged local fileSync map writes with a transaction origin so the observer ignores self-writes and no longer double-triggers on a single action
